title: Key-only primary-key equality lookup
description: Avoid full row decode for primary-key equality queries when projection, selection, and ordering only require the primary key.
constraints: Only use key-derived rows when key_only_scan is already proven safe
convergence_criteria: Primary-key equality lookup returns a key-derived sparse row under key_only_scan
Range/full/index key-only paths share the same helper
A focused SQL integration test verifies SELECT id FROM table WHERE id = value
